conventions.step_indexing: zero-based; transition step s ends at nominal simulated time (s+1)/50 seconds
conventions.eef: actual MuJoCo gripper_link body position, not finger tip or target FK
conventions.object_z: body origin; initial0.05m objects settle under gravity, so vertical displacement alone is not a grasp
conventions.contact_counts: per-contact-point per-post-step; repeated points and persistent contacts are not distinct incidents

comparison_004_005.runtime_packages_and_gpu_same: torch2.8.0+cu128, lerobot0.6.2 pinned revision, gym-aloha0.1.4, RTX4090D, EGL
comparison_004_005.difference_cause: unresolved; no controlled paired rollout; do not call improvement or instrumentation regression

limitations: No expert baseline on these resets; correct action and first expert deviation unknown.
Decoded/executed equality does not prove learned state-image-action correspondence.
Support-clamp comparison is algebra on saved values, not an executed alternative policy or causal ablation.
Contact and pose trajectories localize execution failure; training distribution shift, visual grounding, timing and recovery remain hypotheses.
Trace adds CPU copies/hash/serialization and synchronization timing; no matched CUDA traced/untraced run available.
Version strings do not prove every driver/render/physics binary or deterministic backend flag identical.
recommended_next_evidence: Only after separate authorization/registration: matched traced/untraced reset RGB+state+noise+first-action checks and first-divergence capture, then a controlled hypothesis on the localized no-grasp/unstable-grasp phase. No training restart or checkpoint reselection justified.
